advice.headline: Stay the course

moves.text: Pick up Elijah Higgins off waivers (+1.3 points a week) and drop Matt Hibner.

reasons: You're 15-7 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 23%.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 1st of 8 contenders (175.5 points a week).
Your weakest position is WR (11th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 1st in 2026, 1st in 2027 and 1st in 2028 (title chances about 23%, 23%, 25%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.
We tested the best fair trade with 6 teams and none clearly raises your title chance beyond the simulation's margin (about 2 points).
Re-check before the deadline (2 weeks left): injuries change this quickly.
watch: Dallas Goedert is Questionable. He's one of your most important players (3.3 points a week).

Chase Brown's trade value has dropped 40% in 30 days.
Bryce Young's trade value has dropped 43% in 30 days.
C.J. Stroud's trade value has dropped 15% in 30 days.
